economic_mother: non-extended three-session demand impulse, immediate low-turnover inside day, then first completed close above the frozen inside-day high within five sessions
visual_questions: Did the impulse begin from a genuine base or from a late extended rise?
Was the inside-day contraction real supply contraction or merely a pause inside unstable price action?
Did the delayed breakout clear meaningful prior overhead or remain inside a larger distribution range?
Was the broad market causally accelerating or decelerating at the signal close?
Are outcomes repeated across independent signal dates or concentrated in synchronized market bursts?

causal_market_descriptors.base_regime: BULL only when market median ret20 and ret60 are positive and both positive-return shares exceed 50%; BEAR only for the symmetric non-positive state; otherwise TRANSITION

rule_budget_after_visual_review.next_step: freeze one simple causal rule set before any later-period evaluation
